posts.description: 2016 had its fair share of notable political events, but few could have expected that North Carolina would deliver one of the most memorable. posts.title: Politics at Work: What does Corporate America Think?
posts.description: One of the standard tropes of political discourse is that the left is for labour and the right is home of the corporate elite. We know that narrative has been breaking, but the way we usually understand it is via a migration of the working class, of globalization’s forgotten, shifting to the likes of the GOP and the AfD. posts.title: Politics at Work: Corporate Mobilization
posts.description: We have a clear image of corporate power. Big firms make lots of money and they use those profits to purchase politicians and dictate elections.
